_comment: TEST VALUES for `render-native-screen.mjs --api fixture`: invented, clearly marked as tests, never real patient data. They exist only to draw the data-bound blocks of Home (name, reminder, appointment, records, curated offers) and the pharmacy hub and product screens (a catalogue of marked test products) in a design render. Shipped code never reads this file. Batch 1c adds TEST pharmacy offers and orders (the shape of the backend patient endpoints; names, prices and ids are invented). Batch 1d adds TEST orders for payment, insurance decision and checkout, TEST payment capabilities and TEST payment results (the shape of the backend answers of payments.module.ts and pharmacy-order.service.ts; amounts and ids are invented). Batch 5 adds TEST health data (vitals, score, reminders, sleep, medical profile, contacts, records, wearables) in the shape the health screens read; names, values and ids are invented.
